name: RealDentalCostsAPI
summary: Swift client for the Real Dental Costs open data API (U.S. dental prices by state, Medicaid T-MSIS payments)
description:
A minimal Swift client (URLSession, async/await) for the Real Dental Costs open data API: U.S. dental procedure prices by state, and Medicaid dental payment data derived from CMS T-MSIS.

Data sources and further reading:
  * Real Dental Costs open data & API - https://realdentalcosts.com/en/api/
  * Dentures cost by state (2026) - https://realdentalcosts.com/en/dentures/
  * Root canal cost by state - https://realdentalcosts.com/en/root-canal/
  * Dental implants cost by state - https://realdentalcosts.com/en/dental-implants/
  * Medicaid dental coverage by state (T-MSIS) - https://realdentalcosts.com/en/medicaid-dental-coverage-by-state/
  * Methodology & sources - https://realdentalcosts.com/en/methodology/
